skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the basics of land databases and land information systems.
Students will be able to analyze land data for various purposes such as valuation, statistics, tax assessment, etc.
Students will learn how to design land databases that meet specific requirements.
Students will become proficient in using Mapinfo software for land database management.
Students will be able to manage and utilize land data effectively.
Students will develop the ability to independently study and apply new concepts and tools.
